scope: Directly compiled pinned native remote.rs codec; sidecar SendAttempt decision transcribed from sidecar.rs:2682-2700. No Iroh/QUIC, TLS, retry lifecycle or cleanup execution.
format: TSV name, hexadecimal wire bytes, decode error code or ok, numeric RemoteKind or -, sidecar SendAttempt for request ID [5;16]. generation_transfer is an outbound byte vector; SendAttempt applies only when misused as a response.
